_metadata.description: Static and live validation of the standard /health API readiness surface.

requirements.title: Root health endpoint exists and is an ops probe
requirements.description: Static validation confirms the API exposes root /health as the lifecycle probe and treats optional /api/v1/health as additional client convenience, not a replacement.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/validation/health_static_test.go. Fixtures for root health, only versioned health, healthz only, comments-only false positives, and endpoint descriptor tags.

requirements.title: Live health probe validates bounded schema
requirements.description: When execution is requested, API Health resolves the target through lifecycle, calls the configured API health URL once within a timeout, validates JSON content type and the api-core health response fields, and records probe evidence in native detail.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/validation/health_probe_test.go. httptest cases for healthy, degraded, unhealthy, timeout, non-JSON, malformed JSON, and unreachable service.

requirements.title: Readiness semantics are consistent with status
requirements.description: The validator reports inconsistent health payloads, such as status=unhealthy with readiness=true or missing dependency details for declared critical resources.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/validation/health_schema_test.go. Schema fixtures for status/readiness combinations and dependency maps.
